_comment: NOT YET APPLIED. Four generated Part 2 items have two defensible responses (2026-09-12 learning-quality review, F04): p2-gen-179 'I'll check the supply closet for you' vs the direct location; p2-gen-116 'They should arrive by the end of the month' is a valid 'not yet'; p2-gen-136 'the order was processed last week' reads as an indirect yes; p2-gen-186 'I haven't checked the shipment yet' is a textbook acceptable reply to a tag question. Each already has recorded audio, so the text cannot change until the recording does: apply with `npx tsx src/apply-p2-uniqueness-patch.ts`, then regenerate audio with `npx tsx src/generate-audio.ts --question <id> --force` for each id, then remove the ids from DISPUTED_QUESTIONS in data/question-revisions.ts. Only the flawed distractor is rewritten; the key, id, answer letter, difficulty and skill_tag are preserved; audioScript is derived by the applier from prompt + choices.

p2-gen-179.question: Where are the replacement printer cartridges kept?

choices.A: They need to be ordered by Friday.
choices.B: The printer was replaced last month.
choices.C: The cartridges are stored in the supply closet.

p2-gen-179.explanation_zh: Where 問句問替換墨水匣放在哪裡。(C) 直接說出位置：存放在用品儲藏室。(A) 回答的是何時要訂購，答非所問。(B) 用 printer、replaced 這些和問句相近的字（replacement／printer）製造聯想，但講的是印表機上個月換新了，沒有回答地點，是典型的相似字陷阱。

p2-gen-116.question: Did the new office chairs arrive yet?

choices.A: Yes, they were delivered this morning.
choices.C: They're for the new meeting room.

p2-gen-116.explanation_zh: Yes/No 問句問新辦公椅到了沒。(A) 直接回答：到了，今天早上送達。(B) 重複 chairs，講的是椅子可調整，沒有回答到貨與否。(C) 講的是椅子要放在哪個會議室，回答了「用途」而不是「到了沒」。

p2-gen-136.question: Did you order more office supplies for the team yet?

choices.B: The team meeting is on Thursday.
choices.C: Yes, I've just placed the order.

p2-gen-136.explanation_zh: Yes/No 問句問「你訂了更多辦公用品沒」。(C) 直接肯定：是，我剛下單。(A) 重複 supplies，講的是用品已送達，沒有回答有沒有訂。(B) 重複 team，講的是週四的會議，與訂購無關，是聽到熟字就選的陷阱。

p2-gen-186.question: The shipment arrived on time, didn't it?

choices.A: Yes, it was delivered this morning.
choices.B: The shipment is for next week.

p2-gen-186.explanation_zh: 附加問句（…, didn't it?）尋求確認。(A) 直接確認：是，今天早上送達了。(B) 重複 shipment，但講的是下週的貨，答非所問。(C) 用發音相近的 ship 製造混淆，講的是船從 4 號碼頭出發，與貨有沒有準時到達無關。
